name: @cas/export
description: Shared figure-export primitives for the suite: PNG `tEXt` metadata (crc32, injectPngText, readPngText) — the 'a figure carries its own recipe' mechanism that splices a permalink / parameters into an exported PNG before IEND with a correct CRC-32, without touching a pixel. Pure, DOM-free, convention-neutral (ADR-0006).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
